author: More Perfect Union
description:
Billionaire oligarchs are out to destroy cinema as we know it.

Workers are sounding the alarm that the $110 billion Paramount-Warner megamerger will bring mass layoffs, cutbacks, and movie theater shutdowns across America.

They’re fighting the billionaire takeover of our media, along with 12 states and the Writers Guild of America, that are suing the studios to block it.

Producers: Meagan Day, Trevor Hayes
Editor/Host: @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Billionaires could ruin the movie industry — and people are FURIOUS

author: More Perfect Union
description:
LEAKED AUDIO: Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth told employees that he would like to sue workers who leak, saying on a weekly meeting: "We fine and fire leakers all the time. We tend not to sue those people, but I'd like to..."

When Meta began using employee data to train AI without worker consent, over 1,800 Meta workers signed a petition asking to end the Model Capability Initiative (MCI). Bosworth claims these people “made the entire company worse.”

Because of the workers collective action and an internal data breach where private data was exposed, Meta management ended the nonconsensual MCI surveillance program.

Now the company's CTO is lashing out against workers, and appears to be equating worker organizing to leaking, even hinting at threatening workers for their protected organizing.
title: CTO of Meta crashes out, threatens staff, says to stop leaking information to the press
